Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-01.html.text: Magister Kaira: We Dark Elves believe that hidden truths and new knowledge will make us stronger. The power of darkness that so frightens your tribe, the ultimate secrets veiled under the abyss of darkness.... We have explored and managed fearlessly. That is our strength. (Quest for Dark Elven char…

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-06.html.text: Magister Kaira: Go to Einhasad's Temple and meet Brother Metheus . He has offered to give us the Alder's remains. You must be careful and very discreet.

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-07.html.text: Magister Kaira: I had a feeling that he expected something in return. Well, we have no choice. Do whatever he asks that is within your power. The most important thing is that we acquire the revelation.
when: state STARTED; has items 3174,3175; lacks items 3173

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-08.html.text: Magister Kaira: Belladonna ? When it comes to poison, Master Ixia from the Town of Dion is the expert. You should consult her. By the way, this guy Metheus...he is more dangerous than I thought. I had no idea that his heart was so full of hatred and revenge.
when: state STARTED; has items 3176,3177; lacks items 3173,3174,3175

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-09.html.text: Magister Kaira: At last you have brought Alder's Skull . With this we can perform the exorcism ritual and summon the spirit of Alder. Let us begin... In the name of Shilen, Master of hell, Queen of the dead, thou who hast crossed the waters of forgetfulness, spirit of Eldus Bricent... Cross the bor…
when: state STARTED; has items 3184; lacks items 3173,3174,3175,3176,3177

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-10.html.text: Magister Kaira: You must find the descendant of Alder named 'Roa' immediately! Tell him the secret that Alder's spirit whispered to you and find out where the revelation is hidden.
when: state STARTED; has items 3185,3186; lacks items 3173,3174,3175,3176,3177,3184

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-11.html.text: Magister Kaira: The complete copy of the revelation which was thought to be lost 200 years ago is in our hands at last! Good job, brother of darkness. Thanks to your efforts our tribe will have an even better understanding of the dark arts. In return for your efforts I will give you the opportunity…

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-15.html.text: Magister Kaira: Good. Now you are ready! I will write a Letter of Recommendation for you. Take this letter to Tetrarch Thifiell in the Dark Elf Village . You will be given Shilen's Initiation and receive the Abyssal Mark.

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-16.html.text: Magister Kaira: You must go back to the Dark Elven Forest and meet Tetrarch Thifiell . Follow his instructions and take 'Shilen's Initiation' . You will then receive the 'Mark of Fate' which is essential for advancement. Please hurry!

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-17.html.text: Magister Kaira: I pray you pass 'Shilen's Initiation' and are advanced to a higher rank. May the eye of the abyss lead you.

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30476-01.htm.text: Magister Kaira: I heard that Orim of the Shadows is looking for this jewel.... Are you sent by him? No doubt, it is obvious. Do you know what kind of jewel this is? What did he tempt you with? Do you think that you can learn all the secrets of Black magic just from this jewel? If you are stupid eno…
when: state STARTED; has items 3309; lacks items 3318

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30476-03.htm.text: Magister Kaira: Do you have any idea what the jewel you have taken is capable of? A wise Wizard would never give or take such an object so carelessly.

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30476-04.htm.text: Magister Kaira: Well, now you know of the evil that dwells in the jewel... You wouldn't have listened even if I had warned you. You people never trust Dark Elves!
when: state STARTED; has items 3323,3324; lacks items 3309

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-04.htm.text: Magister Kaira: At last there is news of 'Kaysha's Revelation' , which was thought lost. While the Human religious reformation distorted many facts about the goddess Shilen, this revelation contains the truth written in the Age of Giants. If only we could recover it we would gain a better understan…

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-05.htm.text: Magister Kaira: Legend says that the Remains of Alder rest here in this village, in the shrine of Einhasad. If we acquire the remains, we could summon the spirit of Alder and ask him where he hid his copy of the revelation. Recently brother Metheus contacted us and offered to hand over the remains.…

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-05a.htm.text: Magister Kaira: Alder's Ash lies in the Einhasad Temple here in town. If you can obtain it, you can use the exorcism ritual to call the Alder's spirit from Purgatory and ask where the Revelations are kept. Not long ago, Brother Metheus contacted us and said that he could give the Alder's Ash to us.…

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-12.html.text: Magister Kaira: I shall write you a Recommendation letter. Take it to Tetrarch Thifiell in the Dark Elves' Village . You will be given 'Shilen's Initiation' . When you successfully complete this test, you will receive the 'Mark of Fate' from the Tetrarch.

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-13.html.text: Magister Kaira: Your ambition is admirable, but you are still unprepared to take 'Shilen's Initiation'. Come back after you have accumulated more experience, then I will write you the letter of Recommendation.

Q00219_TestimonyOfFate/30476-14.html.text: Magister Kaira: Your time has not yet come. You must prepare more to realize your ambitions. Come back after you have accumulated more experience, then I will write you the Recommendation letter you must have in order to take 'Shilen's Initiation'.

Q00229_TestOfWitchcraft/30476-02.htm.text: Magister Kaira: Good. You may have it. Money will not purchase this, however. Instead you'll have to pay for it in another way .

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30476-note.text: Magister Kaira: I do not receive students other than Mystics of Dark Elven race. I am sorry, but I don't have any business with you. Now if you'll excuse me.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30476.html.text: Magister Kaira: Rest easy, traveler. I can tell you've come a long way. I teach magic to my Dark Elf brothers. I also trace the whereabouts old relics or forgotten archeological sites in my spare time. Perhaps I will find clues concerning the lost Dark Magic of the ancient Giants.

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
